name: Show Contact Picker( { top { ; left { ; allowMultiple } } } )
purpose: Opens the contact picker (public API, 2017 v2.0): merges the caller's JSON settings (multi-select, organizations only, allow create, placeholder and footer text, subtype filters, window position) over defaults into Picker::Settings, resets Picker::Results, clears the search, runs Configure (26), Init Field References (95) and Reset Rows Table (85), opens a card (or a dialog window if the card fails), starts from a list of party ids or a default find (69), and pre-selects existing subscribers (71). Returns True.
writes:
Picker::Settings#4 (Set Field step 11, current record)
Picker::Results#2 (Set Field step 14, current record)
Picker::Search_Field#1 (Set Field step 29, current record)
VIRTUALLISTS::foundCount#1 (Set Field step 30, current record)
selector::PartyId#6 (Set Field step 57, global)
calls:
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/26 ("Configure", step 37)
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/95 ("Init Field References", step 40)
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/85 ("Reset Rows Table", step 43)
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/69 ("Find Contacts", step 62)
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/71 ("Select Party", step 77)
open_question: Writes the Picker record that is current in the caller's context (the Picker table is not switched to). Step 52 (Resize to Fit) is disabled. The inner loop walks every found party for each subscriber id (steps 69-85), so cost grows with found count x subscribers. Show Omitted Only at step 90 is disabled.

name: Get Results
purpose: Returns the picker's result JSON (Picker::Results: CreateParty flag, PartyCount, PartyArray) so callers need no relationship to this file.
